disclaimer: Scope: analyses are derived from orbital remote-sensing and model products. Traverses are simulated candidates on a documented cost model; water-ice results are relative investigation priorities, not detections. Results support, and do not replace, mission certification and in-situ confirmation.

dataset.title: Nobile crater — LOLA 80 m/px (real data)
dataset.region_note: 119 x 119 km window centred on the IAU gazetteer centre of Nobile (-85.28°, 53.27°E, D = 79.3 km).
dataset.citation: Barker et al. (2023) PSJ 4:183 doi:10.3847/PSJ/acf3e1; Paige et al. (2010) Science 330:479; Mazarico et al. (2011) Icarus 211:1066

elevation.units: m, height relative to 1737.4 km reference sphere
elevation.source_name: NASA GSFC PGDA — LOLA south pole 80 m DEM
elevation.acquisition: LRO mission 2009– (multi-year altimetry; see Barker et al. 2023)
elevation.crs: IAU Moon south polar stereographic (R=1737.4 km)

elevation_uncertainty.crs: IAU Moon south polar stereographic (R=1737.4 km)

effective_resolution.crs: IAU Moon south polar stereographic (R=1737.4 km)

slope_reference.crs: IAU Moon south polar stereographic (R=1737.4 km)

psr_mask.units: 1 = PSR, 0 = not PSR (averaged to 80 m: PSR fraction)
psr_mask.processing_level: Derived from illumination modelling, not image darkness
psr_mask.source_name: PGDA LOLA permanently shadowed region map
psr_mask.crs: IAU Moon south polar stereographic (R=1737.4 km)

illumination_avg.units: fraction of time the solar disc is visible
illumination_avg.crs: IAU Moon south polar stereographic (R=1737.4 km)

earth_visibility_avg.units: fraction of time the Earth disc is visible
earth_visibility_avg.crs: IAU Moon south polar stereographic (R=1737.4 km)

thermal_max.processing_level: PDS L5 model-fit product, resampled by scripts/rasterize_diviner_prp.py
thermal_max.source_name: Diviner Polar Resource Product (south), annual max surface temperature
thermal_max.crs: IAU Moon south polar stereographic (R=1737.4 km)

thermal_avg.processing_level: PDS L5 model-fit product, resampled by scripts/rasterize_diviner_prp.py
thermal_avg.source_name: Diviner Polar Resource Product (south), annual average temperature, 2 cm depth
thermal_avg.crs: IAU Moon south polar stereographic (R=1737.4 km)

ice_stability_depth.units: m (deeper than 2.87 m is encoded as 999)
ice_stability_depth.processing_level: PDS L5 model-fit product, resampled by scripts/rasterize_diviner_prp.py
ice_stability_depth.source_name: Diviner Polar Resource Product (south), modelled water-ice stability depth
ice_stability_depth.crs: IAU Moon south polar stereographic (R=1737.4 km)

crater.name: Nobile
crater.note: Near Mons Mouton, the former VIPER landing region

elevation.title: Elevation (LOLA)
elevation.method: Block-mean 2x2 of source DEM (cells need >=75% valid sub-pixels).
limitations: Gridded from altimetry tracks; interpolated between tracks (see effective resolution).
Heights are relative to a sphere, not a geoid.

hillshade.title: Hillshade (visual aid)
limitations: Not a simulation of real lunar illumination; polar sun is near the horizon.

slope.title: Slope
slope.method: Horn (1981) finite differences on the analysis grid; NaN propagates from no-data.
limitations: Baseline 320 m: slopes at rover-wheel scale can be steeper.
Polar stereographic scale error <= 0.427% ignored.

roughness.title: Roughness (detrended RMS)
roughness.method: Least-squares plane removal per window (separable correlation).
limitations: Scale-dependent; sub-cell roughness (boulders) is not captured.

elevation_uncertainty.title: DEM uncertainty (PGDA)
limitations: Producer model of error; not ground truth.

effective_resolution.title: DEM effective resolution
limitations: Large values mean heights are interpolated between sparse tracks.

uncertain.title: Elevation flagged uncertain
uncertain.method: Threshold on producer uncertainty layers (prototype thresholds).

slope_reference.title: Slope — PGDA reference
limitations: Different baseline than our slope; differences are expected.

psr.title: Permanently shadowed regions
psr.method: Block mean of the producer's 0/1 PSR map (illumination modelling on LOLA topography).
limitations: Model of illumination over the modelled epoch; small PSRs below grid scale are smoothed.

thermal_max.title: Annual max temperature (Diviner PRP)
thermal_max.method: Thermal-model fit (PDS PRP) resampled nearest-facet then block-averaged.
limitations: Model product fitted to the first year of Diviner data; native facet spacing is coarser than this grid.
A single temperature does not describe sub-facet conditions (micro cold traps).

thermal_avg.title: Annual mean temperature, 2 cm depth (Diviner PRP)
thermal_avg.method: Thermal-model fit (PDS PRP) resampled nearest-facet then block-averaged.
limitations: Model product fitted to the first year of Diviner data; native facet spacing is coarser than this grid.
A single temperature does not describe sub-facet conditions (micro cold traps).

ice_stability_depth.title: Ice stability depth (Diviner PRP)
ice_stability_depth.method: Thermal-model fit (PDS PRP) resampled nearest-facet then block-averaged.
limitations: Model product fitted to the first year of Diviner data; native facet spacing is coarser than this grid.
A single temperature does not describe sub-facet conditions (micro cold traps).
999 encodes 'deeper than 2.87 m'.

illumination_avg.title: Average sun visibility (18.6-yr)
illumination_avg.method: LOLA horizon modelling, hourly over 18.6 yr; 60 m product resampled bilinearly, then block mean.
limitations: Long-term average, not the conditions on any specific date.
60 m native resolution; horizons from LOLA topography.

earth_visibility_avg.title: Average Earth visibility (18.6-yr)
earth_visibility_avg.method: LOLA horizon modelling, hourly over 18.6 yr; 60 m product resampled bilinearly, then block mean.
limitations: Long-term average, not the conditions on any specific date.
60 m native resolution; horizons from LOLA topography.

hydrogen.title: LEND hydrogen
limitations: not provided by this dataset

hazard.title: Mobility hazard class
hazard.method: Slope edges [10.0, 15.0, 25.0] deg, blocked >= 25.0 deg; roughness high >= 2.0 m, blocked >= 6.0 m.
limitations: PROTOTYPE thresholds, not a certified rover specification.
Unknown cells (no data) are never classed as safe.

cost.title: Traversal cost multiplier
limitations: Relative cost; not energy or time.
Weights are prototype assumptions.

priority_score.title: Ice investigation priority (score)
limitations: Investigation priority, NOT detection of water ice.
Weights are explicit prototype choices; see sensitivity.
Layers missing: hydrogen.

priority_class.title: Ice investigation priority (class)
limitations: Investigation priority, NOT detection of water ice.
Weights are explicit prototype choices; see sensitivity.
Layers missing: hydrogen.

priority_sensitivity.title: Priority sensitivity (std)
limitations: High values: ranking depends on weight choices.

slope_vs_reference.note: Consistency check against the producer slope (same source DEM; not independent validation). Our slope uses a coarser baseline, so it is expected to be lower on average.

boulder_detection.reason: grid is 160 m/px; rover-scale boulders (<10 m) are sub-pixel. Requires native-resolution NAC/ShadowCam imagery (~0.5–2 m/px) and a labelled training/evaluation set.

ice_investigation_priority.wording: Relative investigation priority from available evidence. Not a detection of water ice.

route.label: Simulated candidate route — not mission-certified
route.cost_semantics: Path cost = sum over moves of step length x mean per-metre cost multiplier of the two cells; a value equal to the length means flat, certain, low-hazard terrain all the way. Relative units — not energy, time or risk probability.
route.reason: no traversable path between start and goal

assumptions: Slope classes [10.0, 15.0, 25.0] deg and blocked >= 25.0 deg are prototype assumptions.
Roughness high >= 2.0 m, blocked >= 6.0 m RMS (prototype).
Cost weights {'slope': 8.0, 'roughness': 3.0, 'uncertainty': 4.0, 'psr': 1.5} are prototype choices; cost is relative, not energy or time.
Ground distance equals grid distance (polar stereographic scale error < 0.04 % within 2 deg of the pole).
No-data and unknown cells are treated as blocked for routing.
limitations: Analysis grid 160.0 m/px: rover-scale obstacles (boulders, small craters) are not resolved.
PSR map, temperatures and ice-stability depth are model products, each with its own epoch and resolution.
No LEND hydrogen layer was used; no direct measurement of water ice is included.
Illumination, communications line-of-sight and thermal survival are not modelled in the route.
Layer 'LEND hydrogen' unavailable: not provided by this dataset
